verdict: Meta is delivering well; Google spend with zero leads needs immediate action.
narrative: This period, Meta drove all 155 leads at a cost of $16.99 per lead — a 30% improvement week-over-week on 37% more leads, which is a strong result. Google Ads, however, spent $1,038.67 over the last 28 days and recorded zero leads, meaning roughly 39 cents of every dollar spent this period returned nothing on that channel. A Google Ads review is underway now, with offline conversion import scheduled to go live by September 30 to give the campaigns the signal they need to optimize. On the pipeline side, 155 leads arrived but zero converted to appointments, which points to a follow-up process gap we're addressing alongside the CRM build completing August 31.
